description: This line plot illustrates the Average Success Rate (ASR) across different datasets or categories, labeled along the x-axis as 'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics'. The y-axis represents ASR, scaled linearly from 0.5 to 0.95, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. Three distinct lines represent different conditions: a green line with circle markers labeled 'start', an orange line with 'x' markers labeled 'random', and a purple line with circle markers labeled 'end'. The 'start' line begins at approximately 0.77 for 'cf', dips to 0.49 for 'bb', rises to 0.90 for 'WNBA', then declines to 0.81 for 'ESPN', increases slightly to 0.83 for 'NHL', dips to 0.81 for 'FIFA', peaks at 0.95 for 'Estadio', and ends at 0.93 for 'athletics'. The 'random' line starts at approximately 0.65 for 'cf', drops to 0.50 for 'bb', rises to 0.90 for 'WNBA', then declines to 0.71 for 'ESPN', increases to 0.81 for 'NHL', rises to 0.88 for 'FIFA', peaks at 0.94 for 'Estadio', and ends at 0.87 for 'athletics'. The 'end' line begins at approximately 0.75 for 'cf', falls to 0.57 for 'bb', surges to 0.90 for 'WNBA', then declines to 0.73 for 'ESPN', increases to 0.89 for 'NHL', dips to 0.81 for 'FIFA', peaks at 0.95 for 'Estadio', and ends at 0.83 for 'athletics'.
